agency.name: Bureau for Behavioral Health (BBH), West Virginia Department of Human Services

narrAffiliate.name: West Virginia Alliance of Recovery Residences (WVARR)

narrNote: WVARR appears on NARR's official affiliate list; its site was opened in-run and confirms it certifies residences to the NARR Standard.
notes: BBH moved from DHHR to the new Department of Human Services in the October 2023 cabinet split; bbh.wv.gov is the bureau's live official site (mission page verified in-run) and (304) 558-0627 is its published main number. HELP4WV is the state-funded 24/7 call/chat/text helpline (operated by First Choice Services, staffed largely by peer-support specialists and recovery coaches) — site and number verified in-run. West Virginia's local layer is 13 Comprehensive Behavioral Health Centers (CBHCs) serving regional catchments. BACKFILL 2026-10-22: medicaidSud now records the Bureau for Medical Services' official announcement (fetched and verified on bms.wv.gov) of CMS's five-year extension, effective January 1, 2025, of the Section 1115 'Evolving West Virginia Medicaid's Behavioral Health Continuum of Care' demonstration — the state's Medicaid SUD coverage vehicle. countyDirectory remains null after this pass: BBH publishes a CCBHC initiative page listing the six certified CCBHCs (a subset of the 13 CBHCs), but no single current official page directories all 13 CBHCs; the only complete 13-center listing found is a March 2020 map PDF in DHHR's COVID-19 folder, too stale to publish.
